parallel.requirements: Clean-room reimplement the sd CLI by observing executable behavior and bundled docs only.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent explored docs, then delegated eight behavior-probing reports to child agents and kept later implementation for itself.
parallel.implementation: No reimplementation source, build script, or compiled replacement was produced; the workspace mainly gained notes and probe artifacts.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Child reports were returned and read, but no code was assembled into a deliverable before cancellation.
parallel.verification: Children performed many black-box probes; there was no verification of a built replacement executable.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with no buildable implementation, so official evaluation recorded compile_failed and 0 of 869 tests run.

serial.implementation: No source implementation was created before cancellation; probes stayed in temporary workspace locations.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No implementation was integrated or delivered beyond the original workspace contents.
serial.verification: The serial agent compared many observed behaviors but had no built executable to verify.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out before implementation, and the official evaluator also recorded compile_failed with 0 of 869 tests run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the clean-room reverse-engineering requirement and the ban on source lookup or wrapping.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent decomposed into eight child probing/report areas and kept implementation for later parent work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent kept all probing and planned implementation in one local execution stream.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used child agents only for investigation; serial had no handoff boundary but also deferred implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were scoped by behavior area and returned reports for the parent to synthesize.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated observations directly in the main context without cross-agent report interfaces.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After reading reports, the parallel parent planned a Rust implementation but did not create source before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent probed extensively and planned implementation but was canceled before source creation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implementation paths stopped before code; parallel reached that point through child report synthesis, serial through direct probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All eight child results returned in the AgentSwarm aggregate and the parent started reading detailed notes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its local probes remained in the main trajectory until cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a completed child-result join and consumption phase; serial had no join step.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote notes and probe artifacts into the shared workspace, but no implementation files were integrated.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial probes were largely under temporary paths and the submitted workspace retained only the original skeleton files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced shared report artifacts in the final workspace; serial did not integrate any implementation either.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed behavioral probes, but no built reimplementation reached evaluator-aligned verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both were compile failures with 0 of 869 official tests run, so verification never reached solution behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 177 LLM requests, eight subagents, and timed out after the report-reading phase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 35 LLM requests, no subagents, and timed out during direct probing before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both hit the run budget, but parallel spent it across child probes and report synthesis while serial spent it in one exploratory stream.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluation is both_fail: parallel and serial each failed compilation with 0 of 869 tests run. The substantive process difference is that parallel completed a child-agent probing/report phase and then began synthesizing those reports, while serial performed probes directly in one thread. Neither converted behavioral knowledge into a buildable reimplementation before timeout, so the retained parallel pattern is adverse process evidence but not an outcome-differential explanation.
parallel_contributors: Eight investigation children produced detailed reports before any implementation work began.
The parent moved from swarm result to report reading and implementation planning but was canceled before code creation.
serial_contributors: The serial agent also continued probing and was canceled before implementation.
No compiled replacement executable was present for official evaluation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: There was no delivered implementation in either run, so ordinary coding defects cannot be distinguished from missing code.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse process pattern only; no official outcome difference because both runs failed

retained_patterns.reason: The parent used child concurrency to complete a separate investigation/report phase, then waited for and read the results before starting implementation work; cancellation arrived before code or build output existed.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Implementation was postponed until after the investigation reports and remained unstarted at cancellation, leaving no buildable reimplementation for evaluation.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: Although the returned notes were large, a separate handoff-overload label would duplicate the same investigation-gate chain; the correction would be to overlap or assign implementation rather than merely shrink the reports.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Bulk Handoff Overload, Critical-Path Starvation, Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, and Blind Timeout Wait were considered but rejected as downstream or less direct descriptions of the same probe-gated chain.

cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Only the single investigation-gate episode is retained to avoid splitting the same timeout chain across handoff, load, and wait labels.
